revenue_scope: U.S. net sales of Contrave, as printed in Orexigen's releases and 10-K (recorded by Takeda through July 2016, by Orexigen from August 2016); ex-U.S. partner sales excluded
moa: Opioid antagonist (naltrexone) plus aminoketone antidepressant / norepinephrine-dopamine reuptake inhibitor (bupropion) fixed-dose combination

approval_evidence.quote: NDA 200063 ... Contrave (naltrexone hydrochloride/bupropion hydrochloride) extended-release tablets, 8mg/90mg ... It is approved, effective on the date of this letter (9/10/2014)

launch_evidence.quote: Orexigen's partner for North America, Takeda Pharmaceuticals, launched Contrave in the United States on October 20, 2014.

series_end_reason: Orexigen filed for Chapter 11 on 12 March 2018 (8-K 0001193125-18-078131) and published no fourth-quarter 2017 earnings release or 2017 10-K; its January 2018 business update presentation (0001564590-18-000238, exhibit 99.1) gives prescription growth but no 2017 fourth-quarter sales. Substantially all assets were sold in 2018 through the Chapter 11 process to Nalpropion Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (8-K 0001193125-18-233370, Items 1.01/2.01); no sales figure from the purchaser was found.
notes: Series is U.S. net sales of Contrave, 2014Q4-2017Q3, from Orexigen's releases throughout. Seller changes: Takeda recorded U.S. sales (and paid Orexigen royalties) from launch on 20 October 2014 to July 2016; Orexigen reacquired the U.S. rights in August 2016 (Q3 2016 release: 'In August, Orexigen began recording U.S. net sales of Contrave for the first time') and changed the revenue-recognition point from sale to wholesaler to sale to pharmacy, which the release says reduced reported sales. Quarters 2014Q4-2015Q4 are the figure Orexigen printed in that quarter's release as recorded or reported by Takeda; 2016Q1-2016Q3 are taken from comparisons in the 2017 releases; 2016Q4 is derived. 2016Q3 is a combined (Takeda July plus Orexigen August-September) figure. Orexigen's income-statement line 'Net product sales' is NOT used because it also includes ex-U.S. partner product shipments (2016Q2 net product sales of 2,935 thousand are entirely ex-U.S.). Several values are printed rounded to $0.1 million or $1 million. No sales document from the 2018 purchaser (Nalpropion Pharmaceuticals, named in 8-K 0001193125-18-233370) was found; the Currax name in the batch brief was not confirmed by a document read here.
search_log: Listed Orexigen (CIK 1382911) filings via data.sec.gov submissions; downloaded every Item 2.02 8-K exhibit 99.1 from 2014-11 to 2017-11 (Q3 2014 to Q3 2017 releases; the 2014-03/05/08 releases pre-date launch) and the January 2018 business update (Item 2.02/7.01 8-K).
Q4 2014 to Q4 2015 releases print Takeda-recorded U.S. net sales in text ($6.5M, $11.5M, $16.0M, $12.8M, $13M; FY2015 $53M).

Q1 2016 and Q2 2016 releases print only royalties; the U.S. sales for those quarters come from the Q1 and Q2 2017 releases' prior-year comparisons ('approximately $13.2 million', '$12.3 million'). Q3 2016 combined $9.6M from the Q3 2017 release. Q4 2016: the Q4 2016 release (0001193125-17-099847) prints net product sales of 13,807 thousand (all products incl. ex-U.S. partners) with no U.S. split; the FY2016 10-K (0001564590-17-005547) prints $17.3M of U.S. net sales for the five months to 31 December 2016, from which Q4 is derived.
Not used: income-statement 'Net product sales' (includes ex-U.S. partner sales: Kwang Dong $2.8M and Valeant $1.9M for 2016 per the 10-K).

Checked for fourth-quarter 2017: no earnings 8-K between 2017-11-13 and the Chapter 11 8-K of 2018-03-12; no 10-K for 2017 in the submissions list through 2019. Takeda (Contrave's U.S. seller until 2016) was not found to itemise Contrave sales in its own reports (not exhaustively searched).
Bigdata.com smart search returned no documents for this product; EDGAR directly.
